parts.text: Regenerate the truth-reader implementation with this latest correction as authoritative and preserve all still-applicable prior requirements. IMPORTANT: preserve the existing ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-map.json contract, including its sentinel_file and mappings object; extend it for truth-readable document registry/provenance rather than replacing existing mappings. Canonical paths must be full repo-relative paths such as ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/Agents.md, ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json, ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/README.md, ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/MANIFEST.md, and ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json. Per-document stable-reader provenance remains owned and updated deterministically by the dependency-sync mechanism only when that canonical source changes. Stable readers remain complete ordered JSON arrays derived mechanically from canonical content. For each challenge, create an ephemeral active seeded projection from the stable reader. THE ACTIVE PROJECTION ITSELF IS NOW THE WORKER EVIDENCE SURFACE; a separate evidence.json is not required unless an existing runtime dependency demonstrably requires it. Each active projection must contain an initially empty submitted_seeds array and an items array. Truth seeds are separate items distributed across the items array. Each seed item must contain at minimum type='truth_seed', a unique seed id, value=<fresh CSPRNG seed>, and proof_slot=<a string of SPACE characters exactly equal in length to the seed value>. The worker must edit the committed active projection itself by (1) copying every seed value into submitted_seeds; ordering of submitted_seeds does NOT matter, but the complete multiset must match exactly with no omissions, additions, or duplicates beyond those actually present; and (2) replacing EVERY space in EVERY seed item's proof_slot with the fixed character '0', yielding exactly '0'.repeat(seed.value.length). The worker must not alter seed values, content items, metadata, provenance, challenge id, item order, or any other projection field. The workflow must retain a trusted exact original seeded snapshot for each active projection so verification can detect unauthorized edits. Verification PASS requires: every selected projection is present; all immutable fields/content/seed values match the original seeded snapshot; submitted_seeds is an exact complete order-insensitive multiset match of that projection's seed values; and every proof_slot is exactly the required all-zero string of matching length. On verification FAIL, do not advance/reset the challenge: restore every worker-edited active projection to its exact original seeded version and commit that restoration using GITHUB_TOKEN so the same challenge can be retried. On PASS, perform one atomic cleanup/reset commit: selector booleans false, remove/clear active challenge snapshots/projections as designed, persist compact PASS status, and do not rewrite unchanged stable readers. Workflow-generated commits must not recursively retrigger. The worker verification workflow must trigger on commits to the active projection files themselves. Keep deterministic Node logic; Gemini must not decide truth, provenance, seed comparison, restoration, or reader construction. Return response_type truth_reader_implementation with files[] containing exact repository paths and COMPLETE contents for every changed/new file, especially dependency-map.json, gemini-supervisor-dependency-sync.yml preserving its existing alignment behavior, deterministic stable-reader sync helper, truth challenge engine, truth challenge workflow, selector/status/catalog surfaces, and any snapshot/state files required.
